svg.text: What each row group records, before and after sorting
1024 random points in 16 row groups of 64. Each rectangle is one row group’s min/max bounds; the dashed box is the query.
The query must read 16 of 16 row groups.
The query must read 4 of 16 row groups.
Same principle as the benchmark: 20M points in 200 row groups went from 200 read to 2 for a small box.
